mission_07: Choosing the right scaling method depends on your data characteristics and the downstream algorithm. MinMaxScaler bounds data to [0,1] but is sensitive to outliers. StandardScaler centers to zero mean and unit variance but assumes approximately normal distributions. RobustScaler uses median and IQR, making it resistant to outliers. In this mission, you will apply all three methods to the same dataset and compare their effects systematically. Understanding the strengths and weaknesses of each method will help you make informed preprocessing decisions in your own projects.
